The '''invasion of Taris''' occurred around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]], when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] was invaded by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Led by [[Darth Gravus]], the Imperial forces razed the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|Republic restoration project]] and destroyed much of the Republic's progress.
